findings.summary: Sample check for R1 is only partially covered by AT1: AT1 tests rejection of chat logs and non-canonical artifacts, but does not test the “exactly one” constraint (e.g., providing multiple plan_package_final.json inputs or multiple canonical planning inputs).

evidence.note: R1 includes an “exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json” constraint.
evidence.quote: SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json... as its sole canonical planning input

evidence.note: AT1 scenarios cover chat logs and non-canonical inputs, but not multiple canonical inputs.
evidence.quote: Attempt to initiate... (a) a valid plan_package_final.json... (b) a chat log... (c) an unapproved non-canonical artifact

evidence.note: Pass criteria focuses on canonical vs non-canonical acceptance/rejection.
evidence.quote: Run (a) is accepted; runs (b) and (c) are rejected...

findings.summary: R1 mentions an “associated structured handoff bundle” as part of the sole canonical planning input, but the O1 Intake Gate component/interface descriptions only name plan_package_final.json (plus repo_context/workspace_context) and do not explicitly include validation/ingestion of the structured handoff bundle.

evidence.note: R1 requires plan_package_final.json plus its structured handoff bundle.
evidence.quote: plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle)

evidence.note: Intake Gate responsibilities list inputs to validate; structured handoff bundle is not explicitly mentioned.
evidence.quote: Validate plan_package_final.json, repo_context.json, workspace_context.json against schemas.

evidence.note: IF1 contract similarly lists only three artifacts.
evidence.quote: Provide plan_package_final.json + repo_context.json + workspace_context.json; receive intake_result.json...
